## 1 · Brief submitted
The brief form's "send" button POSTs here — fire-and-forget, alongside its own WhatsApp handoff, so a dead webhook never costs the customer their page.

This flow only logs and alerts. Building the actual page from the row is still done by hand; see the note at the end of `../docs/idea.md`.

### Before this runs
- `YOUR_SHEET_ID` in the Google Sheets node
- Header Auth credential: `Authorization: Bearer <WhatsApp token>`
- Env: `WA_PHONE_ID`, `OWNER_PHONE`
